releaseNotes: Doubles customer-render export resolution so exported warehouse render PNGs stay sharper when zoomed.
Adds warehouse-item rotation support with 0, 90, 180 and 270 degree directions saved in project/CSV data.
Adds Rotate 90 and Rotate 180 controls in the Warehouse Builder properties panel.
Adds front/rear markers to warehouse items in the editor and customer renders so equipment orientation is visible.
Adds explicit render assets for Packing Area and Packing Machine, and replaces Reception/QA with a dedicated reception-style image.
Upgrades the warehouse render asset pack to higher-resolution component images.
